mission.title: Situation Normal
mission.description: Use old intelligence to strike at Zion's operations in the city.

npc.say: *Si*, {player}, I am very glad that the override routines are gone. Now we can operate most efficiently, yes?
The System is far more than an assembly of programs.

phase.briefing:
Operative, now that Halborn and Carlyne are no longer within the simulation, we are free to employ our programs without risk of losing them to programmatic overrides. Thus, we can move forward with anti-terrorist operations.
One small benefit of our prolonged downtime is that some Zionites appear to have grown lax in their security, possibly having been under the mistaken impression that because we were not actively pursuing them, we had also stepped down our intelligence-gathering functions. This was not the case, and the time has come to utilize information we have had for some time now.
The location you see was disclosed to us by a spy months ago. Remove the Zionites and disable their computer systems.

enter.say: Redpills and computer systems in there. Looks like the old intel is still good.

talk.say: Hey, I'm the one who tipped you guys off. Better take me out too, just to make it look good. Just make it pretty quick, right?

phase.briefing: Good. Information at that site has revealed the presence of one of the locations where they bolster their numbers by extracting other humans from the simulation.

enter.say: Looks like we're on a roll. Over to you.

talk.say: What... What's happening? Your face... It's glowing... So beautiful...

done.say: Hm, that means their ship should be closing in on that guy's pod to pick him up. Maybe we can get Sentinels on that.

objective.text: Trace Evan Quicksey's signal at the computer

phase.briefing: Sources indicate a larger than usual Zion group at the next location.

talk.say: *Ciao, agente.* Lyndon Plunkett and Shelby Aldridge are at your disposal.

objective.text: Lead Lyndon Plunkett and Shelby Aldridge out of the area

enter.say:
Right, I've got more redpill signals in there.
Uh...a *lot* more.

talk.say:
Hi. {player}... Mm-hm. I thought I'd let you know that we're not going to make this easy for you--just in case you had the wrong impression.
You'll need to bring more programs next time.

done.say: Yeah... I think we should probably just go ahead and report this.

mission.finish: Your report has been received. Thank you, {player}.
